products.name: Videoleap
products.note: Mobile video editing AI; effects; templates; Israeli vendor

profile_text.body:
Lightricks is an Israeli AI technology company that describes itself as transforming creative workflows for content creators, marketers, and professionals through tools spanning web, mobile, and open source platforms. The company frames its strategic direction around what it calls the Open Creativity Stack, which it describes as an ecosystem of AI tools and models intended to give creators, studios, and enterprises greater flexibility and speed than what it characterizes as today's closed systems.

The company's tracked AI product is Videoleap, a mobile video editing application that incorporates AI-driven effects and templates. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are currently held for Lightricks in the site's database.
